# domestic-ui

> domestic-ui is a design system built on native HTML, CSS custom properties and cascade layers. Link one stylesheet and plain semantic HTML gets its look in light and dark, with WCAG 2.2 AA as the accessibility baseline; theme it by overriding semantic tokens. It packages existing web standards and well-known patterns: nothing here is original.

To use it, link `css/domestic.css` (copy the `css/` folder or clone https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui). Plain semantic HTML then gets the full look with no classes. Each layout primitive, utility and component has one documented class or attribute API, tuned with custom properties, never with modifier classes. Theme only by overriding semantic `--dui-*` tokens; primitive tokens are internal and may change.

## domestic-ui

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/index.html

domestic-ui is a design system built on native HTML, CSS custom properties and cascade layers. Link one stylesheet and plain semantic HTML gets its look in light and dark, with WCAG 2.2 AA as the accessibility baseline; theme it by overriding semantic tokens. It packages existing web standards and well-known patterns: nothing here is original.

### Install and use

domestic-ui is plain CSS with no build step. Copy the `css/` folder into your project, or clone the repository:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui.git
```

Link the single entry point. Plain semantic HTML then gets the full look; base elements need no classes.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/domestic.css">
```

Its imports use relative paths, so it works from file paths and from subpaths. File paths under `css/` are public API; see [Agent-friendly by design](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/agent-friendly-by-design.md).

### Layer order

`css/domestic.css` declares the [cascade layers](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/cascade-layers.md) once, lowest priority first. Later layers win regardless of selector specificity, and your own unlayered CSS beats all of them.

```css
@layer reset, tokens, base, layout, components, utilities;
```

### Theming

Override semantic `--dui-*` tokens on `:root`, or on an element with `data-theme` to scope a theme ([Theming](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/theming.md), [theming example](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/theming.html)).
Force a color scheme on the page or any subtree with `data-color-scheme="light"` or `data-color-scheme="dark"`.

#### Base elements

- [Base elements](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/base.md): Native HTML elements styled by the base layer, with no classes.

#### Atoms

Coming in M2; see the [components README](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/README.md).

Coming in M2; see the [components README](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/README.md).

#### Organisms

Coming in M3; see the [components README](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/README.md).

#### Layout primitives

- [Cluster](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/layout/cluster.md): An inline group that wraps onto new lines (buttons, tags, nav links).
- [Grid](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/layout/grid.md): A responsive grid: as many columns as fit, each at least --grid-min wide, never wider than the container.
- [Stack](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/layout/stack.md): Vertical flow with a consistent gap between children.

#### Utilities

- [Visually hidden](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/utilities/visually-hidden.md): Hides content visually but keeps it in the accessibility tree.

## Principles

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/index.html

domestic-ui packages existing web standards and well-known patterns. Nothing here is
original: the rules below come from the [WHATWG HTML Living Standard](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/),
the [W3C CSS specifications](https://www.w3.org/Style/CSS/specs.en.html),
[WCAG 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/), the
[ARIA Authoring Practices Guide (APG)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/) and
[MDN Web Docs](https://developer.mozilla.org/). Where we had to pick between valid
options, the pick is labeled **Our choice:** with one line saying why.

3. [Accessibility baseline: WCAG 2.2 AA](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/accessibility-baseline-wcag-22-aa.md)
4. [Cascade layers](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/cascade-layers.md)
5. [Theming](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/theming.md)
6. [Opinions we hold](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/opinions-we-hold.md)

8. [Tooling](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/tooling.md)

## Native element first

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/native-element-first.html

- Use the HTML element that already has the semantics and behavior you need:
  `<button>`, `<a href>`, `<dialog>`, `<details>`, `<label>`, `<fieldset>`, `<table>`.
  This is the [first rule of ARIA use](https://www.w3.org/TR/using-aria/#rule1) in W3C *Using ARIA*.
- Add ARIA only when native HTML cannot express something, and only in the ways
  [ARIA in HTML](https://www.w3.org/TR/html-aria/) allows. Never add a role an element
  already has (see the [document conformance rules](https://www.w3.org/TR/html-aria/#docconformance)).
- When an interactive widget has no native element, follow its
  [APG pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/) exactly.
- Native behavior beats script: open a `<dialog>` with
  [`showModal()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLDialogElement/showModal)
  or [invoker commands](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Invoker_Commands_API)
  so the browser handles focus, <kbd>Esc</kbd> and inertness.

## Agent-friendly by design

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/agent-friendly-by-design.html

Humans and coding agents should be able to write a whole view from this document alone.

- **Predictable markup.** Plain semantic HTML gets the full look. No wrapper `div`s or
  classes are needed for base elements.
- **One API per thing.** Each layout primitive, utility or component has one documented
  class or attribute, tuned with custom properties, never with modifier classes.
  The API is written in a comment at the top of its CSS file.
- **Paths are API.** `css/domestic.css` and every file under `css/` keep their paths.
  Renaming or moving a file is a breaking change.
- **No hidden JS behavior.** CSS never depends on script. Any script an example uses is
  inline, short, and commented.
- **Our choice:** class and attribute APIs over custom elements, because they work with
  any templating language and need no JavaScript.

## Accessibility baseline: WCAG 2.2 AA

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/accessibility-baseline-wcag-22-aa.html

Every example must pass, and every token pair is tested against, these criteria:

| Topic | Rule | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text contrast | 4.5:1 for body text, in light **and** dark | [1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html) |
| Non-text contrast | 3:1 for control boundaries and the focus indicator | [1.4.11 Non-text Contrast](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/non-text-contrast.html) |
| Links | Links keep their underline; color is never the only cue | [1.4.1 Use of Color](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/use-of-color.html) |
| Focus visible | Every focusable element shows a `:focus-visible` outline | [2.4.7 Focus Visible](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-visible.html) |
| Focus not obscured | `scroll-padding` keeps focused elements clear of sticky edges | [2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-not-obscured-minimum.html) |
| Focus appearance (AAA, optional) | The default 2px solid outline with a 2px offset aims to meet it | [2.4.13 Focus Appearance](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-appearance.html) |
| Target size | Controls are at least 44px tall, above the 24px minimum | [2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum.html) |
| Reduced motion | Duration tokens become `0s` under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` | [MDN `prefers-reduced-motion`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@media/prefers-reduced-motion), [2.3.3 Animation from Interactions](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/animation-from-interactions.html) |
| Color scheme | `color-scheme: light dark` plus [`light-dark()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/color_value/light-dark) in every semantic color | [MDN `color-scheme`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/color-scheme) |
| Forced colors | Borders and outlines switch to system colors | [MDN `forced-colors`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@media/forced-colors) |

- Never remove an outline without a visible replacement.
- Forms: every control has a `<label>`; groups use `<fieldset>` and `<legend>`
  ([W3C forms tutorial](https://www.w3.org/WAI/tutorials/forms/)).
- Tables: a `<caption>` and `th` with `scope` ([W3C tables tutorial](https://www.w3.org/WAI/tutorials/tables/)).
- Images: meaningful `alt` text ([W3C images tutorial](https://www.w3.org/WAI/tutorials/images/)).
- Force a scheme on the page or any subtree with `data-color-scheme="light"` or `"dark"`.

## Cascade layers

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/cascade-layers.html

`css/domestic.css` declares the order once, before anything else
([`@layer` on MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@layer),
[CSS Cascade 5](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-cascade-5/#layering)):

```css
@layer reset, tokens, base, layout, components, utilities;
```

Later layers win over earlier ones regardless of selector specificity, and **your own
unlayered CSS beats all of them**, so overriding never needs `!important` or specificity tricks.

| Layer | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `reset` | A modest reset: `box-sizing`, zero margins, block media, inherited form fonts |
| `tokens` | Primitive and semantic custom properties |
| `base` | Native elements: typography, lists, tables, forms, buttons, dialog, details, focus |
| `layout` | `.stack`, `.cluster`, `.grid` |
| `components` | Molecules and organisms (M2, M3; empty for now) |
| `utilities` | Single-purpose helpers such as `.visually-hidden`; last so they always apply |

**Our choice:** this order, because each layer only refines the ones before it, and a
utility should beat a component the way an inline override would.

## Theming

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/theming.html

### Two tiers of tokens

All tokens are [custom properties](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-variables-1/) on `:root`
with the `--dui-` prefix.

| Tier | File | Named by | Example | Public? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primitive | `css/tokens/primitives.css` | What it is | `--dui-color-blue-600: #3451d1;` `--dui-space-5: 1rem;` | No. Internal, may change in any release. |
| Semantic | `css/tokens/semantic.css` | What it is for | `--dui-color-accent: light-dark(var(--dui-color-blue-600), var(--dui-color-blue-400));` | **Yes.** The stable theming API. |

**Base, layout, utility and component CSS reference only semantic tokens.** They never use
primitives and never hard-code colors or sizes (`0`, `1px` hairlines, percentages, `fr`,
`currentcolor`, `inherit`, `transparent` and system colors are fine). `npm test` enforces
this with `scripts/check-tokens.mjs` (`npm run lint:tokens`), which also rejects literal
colors in `semantic.css`.

**Our choice:** the `--dui-` prefix, so tokens never collide with your own custom properties.

### A theme is a semantic-token override

No build step. Override semantic tokens on `:root` for the whole page, or on any element
with a `data-theme` attribute or a `theme-*` class to scope it:

```css
[data-theme="forest"] {
  --dui-color-surface: light-dark(#f7f5ef, #141a16);
  --dui-color-text: light-dark(#1d2a22, #e4ebe3);
  --dui-color-accent: light-dark(#2f6b3f, #7fcf95);
  --dui-color-accent-contrast: light-dark(#fff, #0f1a13);
}
```

```html
<section data-theme="forest">…</section>
```

[`examples/theming.html`](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/theming.html) shows a full scoped theme next to the default.
Check your theme's contrast in both schemes; `tests/tokens.spec.js` shows how.

A few semantic tokens are defined in terms of others (`--dui-color-link`, `--dui-color-focus`
and `--dui-color-accent-hover` follow `--dui-color-accent`). A custom property's `var()` is
resolved on the element that declares it ([CSS Variables, "Resolving dependency cycles"](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-variables-1/#cycles)),
so these, plus `color`, `background-color` and `font-family`, are re-applied on every
`[data-theme]`, `.theme-*` and `[data-color-scheme]` element.
**Our choice:** `data-theme` (or a `theme-*` class) as the single scoping API, so one attribute
makes an element a theme root. An override on any other selector (say `.sidebar`) still
reaches properties that read the token directly on an element (borders, buttons, links,
headings, controls), but not inherited text color, background or derived tokens. Add
`data-theme` to that element to get the full effect.

### Semantic tokens (public API)

Renaming or removing a semantic token is a **breaking change**. Primitives are internal and
may change. Fluid `--dui-step-*` values are `clamp()` expressions; see `primitives.css`.

| Token | Purpose | Default (primitive, light / dark) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dui-color-surface` | Page and control background | light: `color-gray-0` (#fff)<br>dark: `color-gray-900` (#12151b) |
| `--dui-color-surface-raised` | Slightly lifted areas: neutral buttons, zebra rows, cards | light: `color-gray-50` (#f6f7f9)<br>dark: `color-gray-850` (#1b1f27) |
| `--dui-color-surface-sunken` | Recessed areas: code, button hover | light: `color-gray-100` (#eceef2)<br>dark: `color-gray-800` (#252a34) |
| `--dui-color-text` | Body text | light: `color-gray-900` (#12151b)<br>dark: `color-gray-100` (#eceef2) |
| `--dui-color-text-muted` | Secondary text, captions, list markers (still 4.5:1) | light: `color-gray-600` (#545b68)<br>dark: `color-gray-400` (#a3aab6) |
| `--dui-color-border` | Decorative hairlines: tables, hr, details, fieldset | light: `color-gray-200` (#dde0e6)<br>dark: `color-gray-700` (#3a404b) |
| `--dui-color-border-control` | Form control and button boundaries (3:1) | light: `color-gray-500` (#7a8291)<br>dark: `color-gray-500` (#7a8291) |
| `--dui-color-accent` | Brand color: primary button fill, checks, links and focus by default | light: `color-blue-600` (#3451d1)<br>dark: `color-blue-400` (#8ea2ff) |
| `--dui-color-accent-contrast` | Text on accent | light: `color-gray-0` (#fff)<br>dark: `color-gray-900` (#12151b) |
| `--dui-color-link-visited` | Visited links | light: `color-purple-700` (#6b2fb3)<br>dark: `color-purple-300` (#d2a8ff) |
| `--dui-color-danger` | Errors, :user-invalid borders | light: `color-red-700` (#b42318)<br>dark: `color-red-300` (#ff8a80) |
| `--dui-color-success` | Success messages | light: `color-green-700` (#17773a)<br>dark: `color-green-300` (#5fd38d) |
| `--dui-color-mark` | mark and ::selection background | light: `color-yellow-100` (#fff1a8)<br>dark: `color-yellow-300` (#e3c84f) |
| `--dui-color-mark-text` | Text on mark | light: `color-gray-900` (#12151b)<br>dark: `color-gray-900` (#12151b) |
| `--dui-color-backdrop` | dialog::backdrop | light: `color-black-a40` (rgb(0 0 0 / 40%))<br>dark: `color-black-a60` (rgb(0 0 0 / 60%)) |
| `--dui-color-shadow` | Shadow color | light: `color-black-a10` (rgb(0 0 0 / 10%))<br>dark: `color-black-a40` (rgb(0 0 0 / 40%)) |
| `--dui-font-body` | Body font stack | `--dui-font-stack-system-ui` (`system-ui, sans-serif`) |
| `--dui-font-mono` | Code font stack | `--dui-font-stack-monospace` (`ui-monospace`, …, `monospace`) |
| `--dui-font-weight-body` | Body weight | `font-weight-400` (400) |
| `--dui-font-weight-strong` | strong, labels, buttons, th | `font-weight-600` (600) |
| `--dui-font-weight-heading` | h1–h6 | `font-weight-700` (700) |
| `--dui-step--1` | small, captions | `--dui-font-size-fluid--1` |
| `--dui-step-0` | Body text, h6 | `--dui-font-size-fluid-0` |
| `--dui-step-1` | h5 | `--dui-font-size-fluid-1` |
| `--dui-step-2` | h4 | `--dui-font-size-fluid-2` |
| `--dui-step-3` | h3 | `--dui-font-size-fluid-3` |
| `--dui-step-4` | h2 | `--dui-font-size-fluid-4` |
| `--dui-step-5` | h1 | `--dui-font-size-fluid-5` |
| `--dui-font-size-code` | code, kbd, samp, pre (relative) | `font-size-relative-90` (0.9em) |
| `--dui-line-height-body` | Body text | `leading-160` (1.6) |
| `--dui-line-height-heading` | Headings, buttons, pre | `leading-125` (1.25) |
| `--dui-line-height-display` | h1 | `leading-110` (1.1) |
| `--dui-letter-spacing-heading` | h1, h2 | `tracking-tight` (-0.015em) |
| `--dui-measure` | Max line length for prose | `size-65ch` (65ch) |
| `--dui-space-3xs` | Space scale | `space-1` (0.125rem) |
| `--dui-space-2xs` | Space scale | `space-2` (0.25rem) |
| `--dui-space-xs` | Space scale | `space-3` (0.5rem) |
| `--dui-space-s` | Space scale | `space-4` (0.75rem) |
| `--dui-space-m` | Space scale; default flow rhythm and .stack gap | `space-5` (1rem) |
| `--dui-space-l` | Space scale; default .grid gap | `space-6` (1.5rem) |
| `--dui-space-xl` | Space scale; space above h1–h3 | `space-7` (2rem) |
| `--dui-space-2xl` | Space scale | `space-8` (3rem) |
| `--dui-space-3xl` | Space scale | `space-9` (4rem) |
| `--dui-size-target` | Min height of controls and buttons (WCAG 2.5.8 needs 24px; this gives 44px) | `size-2-75` (2.75rem) |
| `--dui-size-check` | Checkbox and radio size | `size-1-25` (1.25rem) |
| `--dui-size-column-min` | Default .grid min column width | `size-16` (16rem) |
| `--dui-radius-control` | Controls, buttons, inline code | `radius-2` (0.375rem) |
| `--dui-radius-surface` | Panels, pre, dialog, details, media | `radius-3` (0.625rem) |
| `--dui-radius-pill` | Fully rounded ends | `radius-round` (999rem) |
| `--dui-border-width` | Hairline width | `border-1` (1px) |
| `--dui-border-width-emphasis` | blockquote rule | `border-4` (0.25rem) |
| `--dui-underline-offset` | Link underline offset | `underline-offset-015em` (0.15em) |
| `--dui-underline-thickness` | Link underline | `underline-1` (0.0625em) |
| `--dui-underline-thickness-hover` | Link underline on hover | `underline-2` (0.125em) |
| `--dui-focus-width` | Focus outline width | `border-2` (2px) |
| `--dui-focus-offset` | Focus outline offset | `border-2` (2px) |
| `--dui-duration-fast` | Hover transitions (0s with reduced motion) | `duration-150` (150ms) |
| `--dui-duration-normal` | Larger transitions (0s with reduced motion) | `duration-250` (250ms) |
| `--dui-easing-standard` | Easing curve (linear with reduced motion) | `--dui-easing-ease-out` |
| `--dui-opacity-disabled` | Disabled controls | `opacity-60` (0.6) |
| `--dui-color-link` | Links | `--dui-color-accent` |
| `--dui-color-focus` | Focus ring (3:1 against surfaces) | `--dui-color-accent` |
| `--dui-color-accent-hover` | Primary button hover | `color-mix()` of 82% `--dui-color-accent` with `--dui-color-text` |
| `--dui-font-heading` | Heading font stack | `--dui-font-body` |
| `--dui-shadow-raised` | dialog shadow | two-layer shadow using `--dui-color-shadow` |

Derived (re-resolved on each theme scope): `--dui-color-link`, `--dui-color-focus`,
`--dui-color-accent-hover`, `--dui-font-heading`, `--dui-shadow-raised`.

## Opinions we hold

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/opinions-we-hold.html

Each of these is a choice between valid options, not a standard.

- **Our choice:** [logical properties](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/CSS_logical_properties_and_values)
  (`margin-block`, `inline-size`), so right-to-left and vertical writing modes work unchanged.
- **Our choice:** keep link underlines, because color alone is not enough to spot a link (WCAG 1.4.1).
- **Our choice:** system font stacks from [Modern Font Stacks](https://modernfontstacks.com/),
  because they cost no network requests and match the platform.
- **Our choice:** a fluid type scale with [`clamp()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/clamp)
  in `rem`, so text grows with the viewport and still respects the user's font size.
- **Our choice:** a 65ch measure for prose, near the commonly cited 45 to 75 characters per line
  ([WCAG 1.4.8 Visual Presentation](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/visual-presentation.html) asks for 80 or fewer).
- **Our choice:** rhythm from the "lobotomized owl" selector (`* + *`) inside flow containers
  ([Heydon Pickering](https://alistapart.com/article/axiomatic-css-and-lobotomized-owls/)), wrapped in
  `:where()` so it has zero specificity.
- **Our choice:** `type="submit"` buttons get the accent fill and other buttons stay neutral,
  so the primary action is marked by its native type, with no class.
- **Our choice:** checkboxes, radios and range keep native rendering tinted with
  [`accent-color`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/accent-color), because
  native controls keep their platform accessibility.
- **Our choice:** layout primitives come from [Every Layout](https://every-layout.dev/)'s
  Stack, Cluster and Grid. Their custom properties are registered with
  [`@property`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@property) as non-inheriting,
  so a nested primitive keeps its own default.

## Layout primitives

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/layout-primitives.html

| Class | What it does | Custom properties |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.stack` | Vertical flow with a gap | `--stack-gap` |
| `.cluster` | Wrapping inline group | `--cluster-gap`, `--cluster-justify`, `--cluster-align` |
| `.grid` | Auto-fit responsive grid, no media queries | `--grid-min`, `--grid-gap` |

```html
<div class="grid" style="--grid-min: 12rem">…</div>
```

On a `ul` or `ol`, the primitive also removes list markers and padding.

## Tooling

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/tooling.html

`npm test` runs, in order, and fails if any step fails:

| Script | Tool | Checks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lint:html` | [html-validate](https://html-validate.org/) | `examples/**/*.html` against `html-validate:recommended` |
| `lint:css` | [Stylelint](https://stylelint.io/) | `css/**/*.css` against `stylelint-config-standard` |
| `lint:tokens` | `scripts/check-tokens.mjs` | Semantic-only tokens and no literal colors or sizes outside `css/tokens/` |
| `test:a11y` | [Playwright](https://playwright.dev/) + [axe-core](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core) | Every `examples/*.html` in light and dark with tags `wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`, including open dialogs and details; no external requests; token contrast pairs; scoped theming |

Preview locally with `npm run serve` (a zero-dependency static server) and open
<http://127.0.0.1:4173/examples/base.html>.

Rule relaxations, each with its reason:

- **Stylelint `custom-property-pattern`** is replaced, not disabled. The standard kebab-case
  pattern rejects `--dui-step--1` (the double hyphen marks a negative step, a common naming for
  type scales below zero). The replacement still requires kebab-case and only allows names
  starting with `--dui-` or the documented layout properties (`--stack-*`, `--cluster-*`, `--grid-*`).
- **html-validate**: none. `html-validate:recommended` is used as-is. Inline `style` attributes
  that set only custom properties are already allowed by its
  [`no-inline-style`](https://html-validate.org/rules/no-inline-style.html) default
  (`allowVariables: true`), which is how the layout primitives are configured.

## Tokens

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/index.html

All tokens are [CSS custom properties](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/--*) on `:root` with the `--dui-` prefix, in two tiers:

- **Primitive** tokens, in [`css/tokens/primitives.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/tokens/primitives.css), are named by what they are, such as `--dui-color-blue-600`. They are internal and may change in any release.
- **Semantic** tokens, in [`css/tokens/semantic.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/tokens/semantic.css), are named by what they are for, such as `--dui-color-accent`. They are the public theming API: renaming or removing one is a breaking change.

Base, layout, utility and component CSS use only semantic tokens; `npm run lint:tokens` enforces this. To theme, override semantic tokens: see [Theming](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/theming.md) and the [theming example](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/theming.html).

### Semantic token groups

The groups follow the section comments in `css/tokens/semantic.css`.

- [Surfaces and text](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/surfaces-and-text.md): 5 tokens
- [Borders](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/borders.md): 2 tokens
- [Accent and status](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/accent-and-status.md): 9 tokens
- [Type](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/type.md): 18 tokens
- [Space](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/space.md): 9 tokens
- [Sizes](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/sizes.md): 3 tokens
- [Shape](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/shape.md): 8 tokens
- [Focus indicator](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/focus-indicator.md): 2 tokens
- [Motion](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/motion.md): 3 tokens
- [State](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/state.md): 1 token
- [Dependent tokens](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/dependent-tokens.md): 5 tokens

| --- | --- | --- |

| `--dui-color-surface-raised` | `light-dark(var(--dui-color-gray-50), var(--dui-color-gray-850))` | Slightly lifted areas: neutral buttons, zebra rows, cards |
| `--dui-color-surface-sunken` | `light-dark(var(--dui-color-gray-100), var(--dui-color-gray-800))` | Recessed areas: code, button hover |
| `--dui-color-text` | `light-dark(var(--dui-color-gray-900), var(--dui-color-gray-100))` | Body text |
| `--dui-color-text-muted` | `light-dark(var(--dui-color-gray-600), var(--dui-color-gray-400))` | Secondary text, captions, list markers (still 4.5:1) |

## Dependent tokens

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/dependent-tokens.html

Defined in terms of other semantic tokens. A custom property's var() references are substituted on the element that declares it, then the result is inherited. If these lived only on :root, overriding --dui-color-accent on a scoped element would not update --dui-color-link below it. So they are re-declared on every theme scope: an element with a data-theme attribute or a theme-\* class. <https://drafts.csswg.org/css-variables/#cycles> (substitution timing) Our choice: themes are scoped with \[data-theme\] or .theme-\*, so one attribute (or class) is the whole scoping API.

Defined in [`css/tokens/semantic.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/tokens/semantic.css). Values are shown as written there; names inside `var()` that are not semantic tokens are internal primitives (see [Tokens](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/index.md)). Samples are decorative; the token name and value are the reference.

| Token | Value in css/tokens/semantic.css | Purpose (from PRINCIPLES.md) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dui-color-link` | `var(--dui-color-accent)` | Links |
| `--dui-color-focus` | `var(--dui-color-accent)` | Focus ring (3:1 against surfaces) |
| `--dui-color-accent-hover` | `color-mix(in oklab, var(--dui-color-accent) 82%, var(--dui-color-text))` | Primary button hover |
| `--dui-font-heading` | `var(--dui-font-body)` | Heading font stack |
| `--dui-shadow-raised` | `0 var(--dui-border-1) var(--dui-space-2) var(--dui-color-shadow), 0 var(--dui-space-3) var(--dui-space-7) var(--dui-color-shadow)` | dialog shadow |

## Components

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/index.html

Each layout primitive, utility and component has one documented class or attribute API, written in the header comment of its CSS file and tuned with custom properties ([Agent-friendly by design](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/agent-friendly-by-design.md)). Base elements need no API at all: write semantic HTML.

### Base elements

- [Base elements](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/base.md): Native HTML elements styled by the base layer, with no classes.

### Atoms

Coming in M2; see the [components README](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/README.md).

### Molecules

Coming in M2; see the [components README](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/README.md).

### Organisms

Coming in M3; see the [components README](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/README.md).

### Layout primitives

- [Cluster](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/layout/cluster.md): An inline group that wraps onto new lines (buttons, tags, nav links).
- [Grid](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/layout/grid.md): A responsive grid: as many columns as fit, each at least --grid-min wide, never wider than the container.
- [Stack](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/layout/stack.md): Vertical flow with a consistent gap between children.

### Utilities

- [Visually hidden](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/utilities/visually-hidden.md): Hides content visually but keeps it in the accessibility tree.

## Base elements

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/base.html

Native HTML elements styled by the base layer, with no classes.

### API

No classes: write semantic HTML and the base layer styles it.

- `data-color-scheme="light" | "dark"`

### Files in css/base/

| File | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| [`css/base/document.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/base/document.css) | Document, color scheme, rhythm and focus. |
| [`css/base/forms.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/base/forms.css) | Forms and buttons. |
| [`css/base/interactive.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/base/interactive.css) | Interactive elements (dialog, details/summary). |
| [`css/base/media.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/base/media.css) | Embedded content and figures. |
| [`css/base/tables.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/base/tables.css) | Tables. |
| [`css/base/typography.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/base/typography.css) | Headings, text-level semantics and prose blocks. |

### Live example

[Open the example on its own](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/base.html)

### Markup

The content of `<main>` in [`examples/base.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/base.html), unchanged except for removing the common indentation:

```html
      <h1>Base elements</h1>
      <p>
        Every element on this page is plain HTML styled by the <code>base</code> layer.
        There are no component classes. Read the <a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/">WHATWG HTML Living Standard</a>
        for what each element means; this page only shows how it looks.
      </p>

      <section aria-labelledby="text-title">
        <h2 id="text-title">Text</h2>
        <h1>Heading level 1</h1>
        <h2>Heading level 2</h2>
        <h3>Heading level 3</h3>
        <h4>Heading level 4</h4>
        <h5>Heading level 5</h5>
        <h6>Heading level 6</h6>
        <p>
          A paragraph with a <a href="#text-title">link to this section</a>, some <strong>strong importance</strong>,
          <em>stress emphasis</em>, a <mark>highlighted run</mark>, an abbreviation like
          <abbr title="Web Content Accessibility Guidelines">WCAG</abbr>, inline <code>&lt;code&gt;</code>,
          sample output <samp>Saved.</samp>, and keyboard input <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>K</kbd>.
          Prose is capped at a comfortable measure so lines stay readable on wide screens.
        </p>
        <p><small>Small print: side comments such as legal text use <code>&lt;small&gt;</code>.</small></p>
        <p>H<sub>2</sub>O and E = mc<sup>2</sup> keep their line height.</p>
        <hr>
        <blockquote cite="https://www.w3.org/TR/using-aria/#rule1">
          <p>If you can use a native HTML element or attribute with the semantics and behavior you require already built in, instead of re-purposing an element and adding an ARIA role, state or property to make it accessible, then do so.</p>
          <footer>From <cite><a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/using-aria/#rule1">Using ARIA, first rule</a></cite></footer>
        </blockquote>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="lists-title">
        <h2 id="lists-title">Lists</h2>
        <div class="grid">
          <div>
            <h3>Unordered</h3>
            <ul>
              <li>Native elements first</li>
              <li>Tokens as custom properties
                <ul>
                  <li>Primitive</li>
                  <li>Semantic</li>
                </ul>
              </li>
              <li>Cascade layers</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3>Ordered</h3>
            <ol>
              <li>Link the stylesheet</li>
              <li>Write semantic HTML</li>
              <li>Override tokens to theme</li>
            </ol>
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3>Description</h3>
            <dl>
              <dt>Primitive token</dt>
              <dd>A raw value, named by what it is.</dd>
              <dt>Semantic token</dt>
              <dd>A role, pointing at a primitive.</dd>
            </dl>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="code-title">
        <h2 id="code-title">Preformatted code</h2>
        <pre><code>&lt;link rel="stylesheet" href="css/domestic.css"&gt;

:root {
  --dui-color-accent: light-dark(#7a2e8c, #e2a8f0);
}</code></pre>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="interactive-title">
        <h2 id="interactive-title">Dialog and details</h2>
        <p>
          The button below opens a modal <code>&lt;dialog&gt;</code> with
          <a href="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Invoker_Commands_API">invoker commands</a>
          (<code>commandfor</code> and <code>command</code>). The browser moves focus into the dialog,
          closes it on <kbd>Esc</kbd>, and returns focus to the button.
        </p>
        <div class="cluster">
          <button type="button" commandfor="demo-dialog" command="show-modal">Open dialog</button>
        </div>
        <dialog id="demo-dialog" aria-labelledby="demo-dialog-title">
          <h2 id="demo-dialog-title">Delete draft?</h2>
          <p>This removes the draft from this device. You cannot undo it.</p>
          <form method="dialog" class="cluster" style="--cluster-justify: flex-end">
            <button type="button" commandfor="demo-dialog" command="close">Cancel</button>
            <button type="submit" value="confirm">Delete draft</button>
          </form>
        </dialog>

        <details>
          <summary>What is a cascade layer?</summary>
          <p>
            A named bucket of styles. Layers declared earlier lose to layers declared later,
            regardless of selector specificity. See <a href="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@layer">@layer on MDN</a>.
          </p>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>Why keep link underlines?</summary>
          <p>Color alone must not be the only way to identify a link (WCAG 1.4.1).</p>
        </details>
      </section>

      <section id="layout" aria-labelledby="layout-title">
        <h2 id="layout-title">Layout primitives</h2>
        <p>Each primitive is one class, tuned with one or two custom properties.</p>

        <h3><code>.stack</code></h3>
        <div class="stack card" style="--stack-gap: var(--dui-space-xs)">
          <p>Stack item one</p>
          <p>Stack item two, with <code>--stack-gap: var(--dui-space-xs)</code></p>
          <p>Stack item three</p>
        </div>

        <h3><code>.cluster</code></h3>
        <ul class="cluster card">
          <li><code>reset</code></li>
          <li><code>tokens</code></li>
          <li><code>base</code></li>
          <li><code>layout</code></li>
          <li><code>components</code></li>
          <li><code>utilities</code></li>
        </ul>

        <h3><code>.grid</code></h3>
        <div class="grid" style="--grid-min: 12rem">
          <article class="card">
            <h4>Atoms</h4>
            <p>Native elements styled by the base layer.</p>
          </article>
          <article class="card">
            <h4>Molecules</h4>
            <p>Small groups of atoms. Coming in M2.</p>
          </article>
          <article class="card">
            <h4>Organisms</h4>
            <p>Larger sections built from molecules. Coming in M3.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </section>
```

### Accessibility

Each point below is stated in a `css/base/` comment or in [PRINCIPLES.md](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/index.md).

- Links keep their underline, so color is never the only cue ([WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/use-of-color.html)).
- Every focusable element shows a `:focus-visible` outline in `--dui-color-focus`; under `forced-colors: active` it switches to the system `highlight` color ([WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-visible.html)).
- `scroll-padding-block` keeps focused and targeted elements clear of sticky edges ([WCAG 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-not-obscured-minimum.html)).
- Text controls, buttons and summaries are at least `--dui-size-target` tall ([WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum.html)).
- Checkboxes, radios and range keep native rendering, tinted with `accent-color`.
- Open a `<dialog>` with `showModal()` or a `command="show-modal"` button so the browser handles focus, <kbd>Esc</kbd> and inertness ([APG modal dialog pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/)).
- Duration tokens become `0s` under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
- The CSS cannot add semantics for you: give every control a `<label>`, group controls with `<fieldset>` and `<legend>`, give tables a `<caption>` and `th` with `scope`, and give meaningful images `alt` text (see [Accessibility baseline](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/accessibility-baseline-wcag-22-aa.md)).

## Cluster

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/layout/cluster.html

An inline group that wraps onto new lines (buttons, tags, nav links).

### API

```text
class="cluster"
--cluster-gap       space between items   (default: var(--dui-space-s))
--cluster-justify   justify-content value (default: flex-start)
--cluster-align     align-items value     (default: center)
```

### Live example

There is no standalone example page for cluster yet. These example pages use it: [Base elements · domestic-ui](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/base.html), [Theming · domestic-ui](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/theming.html).

### Markup

From the `Example` block in [`css/layout/cluster.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/layout/cluster.css):

```html
<ul class="cluster" style="--cluster-justify: space-between">…</ul>
```

### Notes

Pattern: "The Cluster", Every Layout (<https://every-layout.dev/layouts/cluster/>), built with flex-wrap and gap.

The custom properties do not inherit, so nested clusters keep their defaults.

### Accessibility

The CSS header comment has no accessibility notes. See the spec links below and the [Accessibility baseline](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/accessibility-baseline-wcag-22-aa.md) principle.

### Specs

- **Other**: [every-layout.dev/layouts/cluster/](https://every-layout.dev/layouts/cluster/)

### Source

- [`css/layout/cluster.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/layout/cluster.css)

## Grid

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/layout/grid.html

A responsive grid: as many columns as fit, each at least --grid-min wide, never wider than the container.

### API

```text
class="grid"
--grid-min   minimum column width (default: var(--dui-size-column-min))
--grid-gap   gap between cells    (default: var(--dui-space-l))
```

### Live example

There is no standalone example page for grid yet. These example pages use it: [Base elements · domestic-ui](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/base.html), [Theming · domestic-ui](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/theming.html).

### Markup

From the `Example` block in [`css/layout/grid.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/layout/grid.css):

```html
<div class="grid" style="--grid-min: 12rem">…</div>
```

### Notes

No media queries. Pattern: "RAM" (repeat, auto-fit, minmax), see <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/repeat#auto-fit> and "The Grid", Every Layout (<https://every-layout.dev/layouts/grid/>).

The custom properties do not inherit, so nested grids keep their defaults.

### Accessibility

The CSS header comment has no accessibility notes. See the spec links below and the [Accessibility baseline](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/accessibility-baseline-wcag-22-aa.md) principle.

### Specs

- **MDN**: [developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/repeat#auto-fit](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/repeat#auto-fit)
- **Other**: [every-layout.dev/layouts/grid/](https://every-layout.dev/layouts/grid/)

### Source

- [`css/layout/grid.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/layout/grid.css)

## Stack

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/layout/stack.html

Vertical flow with a consistent gap between children.

### API

```text
class="stack"
--stack-gap   space between children (default: var(--dui-space-m))
```

### Live example

There is no standalone example page for stack yet. These example pages use it: [Base elements · domestic-ui](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/base.html), [Theming · domestic-ui](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/theming.html).

### Markup

From the `Example` block in [`css/layout/stack.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/layout/stack.css):

```html
<div class="stack" style="--stack-gap: var(--dui-space-s)">…</div>
```

### Notes

Pattern: "The Stack", Every Layout (<https://every-layout.dev/layouts/stack/>), built with flexbox gap (<https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/gap>).

--stack-gap does not inherit, so nested stacks keep their own default.

### Accessibility

The CSS header comment has no accessibility notes. See the spec links below and the [Accessibility baseline](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/accessibility-baseline-wcag-22-aa.md) principle.

### Specs

- **Other**: [every-layout.dev/layouts/stack/](https://every-layout.dev/layouts/stack/)
- **MDN**: [developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/gap](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/gap)

### Source

- [`css/layout/stack.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/layout/stack.css)

## Visually hidden

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/utilities/visually-hidden.html

Hides content visually but keeps it in the accessibility tree.

### API

```text
class="visually-hidden"
```

### Live example

There is no standalone example page for visually hidden yet. These example pages use it: [Base elements · domestic-ui](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/base.html), [Theming · domestic-ui](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/examples/theming.html).

### Markup

No markup snippet yet: there is no example page and no `Example` block in the CSS header comment.

### Notes

The well-known pattern from The A11Y Project: <https://www.a11yproject.com/posts/how-to-hide-content/>

### Accessibility

From the CSS header comment: Hides content visually but keeps it in the accessibility tree.

See also the spec links below and the [Accessibility baseline](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/accessibility-baseline-wcag-22-aa.md) principle.

### Specs

- **Other**: [www.a11yproject.com/posts/how-to-hide-content/](https://www.a11yproject.com/posts/how-to-hide-content/)

### Source

- [`css/utilities/visually-hidden.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/utilities/visually-hidden.css)
